hardware.variant: BCM2712 D0; 4 GiB; Generic four-wire PWM fan

scenario: Apply fan_min_level=2, fan_max_only=0 and force_fan=0. Observe automatic cooling during a bounded CPU workload. Verify persistence after a normal reboot. Imported from the cited OS receipt; not rerun for this catalog entry.
expected: The fan starts at the chosen minimum duty, produces tachometer pulses while sampled as active, and retains its policy after reboot.
observed: Cooling began at 50.1 degrees Celsius with 125/255 PWM. All 272 active 30 ms windows had tachometer pulses. No maximum-duty sample, undervoltage or throttle flag occurred. All three settings persisted after reboot.
limits: Generic describes the fan class; another fan is not qualified by this result.
Firmware source pin, carrier revision and fan voltage rating were not established.
Cold power-on, higher-temperature transitions and long runs were not tested.
Sampling does not establish continuous rotation between samples. Pulses per revolution are unknown.
